slide.text: AI reduces intake friction without removing human control
For Lagos, the value of AI is practical: faster document intake, cleaner form completion, and stronger review throughput, while reviewers still decide what enters the official record.

text.p: Officials spend more time re-entering parcel references, applicant details, and supporting-document data by hand.
Queue quality depends heavily on clerical consistency, which becomes harder to maintain under large C of O and approval volumes.
Builders and applicants feel the impact through slower intake confirmation, more back-and-forth, and weaker visibility into why files are held up.
Uploaded PDFs and images can prefill case fields, accelerating data entry and improving consistency across high-volume workflows.
Side-by-side verification lets reviewers compare extracted data with the original evidence before saving changes.
Each field retains provenance, so Lagos can distinguish human-entered values from AI-assisted suggestions inside the audit trail.

slide.text: The procurement value is better throughput and cleaner records, not automation without accountability.
